note: Closed motion vocabulary. Each pattern cites the motion evidence (CLONE_SPEC.md §21 motion index, BUILD_NOTES.md, specs, src). reducedMotionFallback is PRESCRIPTIVE for generated pages: the clone itself only honours prefers-reduced-motion in DemoUnlockHero (sourceHonoursReducedMotion).

static.description: No motion beyond hover micro-interactions (button label scale, underline).

marquee.loop.description: Infinite linear horizontal loop (promo 25s, stats 60s, logo tiles 24-30s); some pause on hover.

nav.dropdown.description: Click-to-open mega dropdown (chevron rotates 300ms ease) and hamburger morph (200ms ease).

parallax.pointer.description: Footer echo wordmarks drift with the pointer (smoothed); static offsets at rest.

countdown.tick.description: Text update every second (not an animation).

tabs.autoplay-progress.description: Tabs autoplay with a progress bar (hero 6s/tab while visible; memberships slider 4s).

panel.fade-scale-in.description: Floating UI panels fade/scale in after a tab activates (400-500ms, delays 600/900ms).

scroll.pinned-scrub.description: Section pins while scroll scrubs its keyframes (why scene 280vh, scale 400vh).

scroll.scrub.description: Scroll-linked property scrub without pinning (hub logos scale in, card heading grows, card stair flattens).

reveal.on-scroll.description: Elements animate in when scrolled into view (flags burst, tools cards, mobile flags).

text.swap-loop.description: Timed fade swap of one word (600ms, 800ms hold).

shimmer.loop.description: Infinite shimmer sweep across an accent (4.5s).

carousel.autoplay.description: Looping slider that autoplays (2000ms delay, 300ms slide) and pauses on hover.

accordion.expand.description: Height expand/collapse with icon rotation (.3s ease); one open at a time.

tabs.fade.description: Pill tabs: pane fades out 100ms then in 300ms.
tabs.fade.match: the pane fades out over 100ms, then the new pane fades in over 300ms

tabs.switch.description: Filter pills swap content instantly (no animation).
tabs.switch.match: 8 filter pills, default "Transaction fees & Usage", instant switch

disclosure.instant.description: Click toggles a disclosure instantly (no animation).
disclosure.instant.match: `FeeDropdowns` (click toggles display, in flow, no animation)

modal.exit-intent.description: Dialog opens instantly on exit intent (no animation).

pulse.loop.description: Background colour pulse cycling across cards (4s / 6s, staggered).

expand.embed.description: Embed widens from half to full width (.5s ease) with text fade.
expand.embed.match: Expand: the text fades (.2s), the embed widens 50% → 100% (.5s ease)

unlock.reveal.description: Unlocking reveals the video and an offer with an entrance animation.
unlock.reveal.match: prefers-reduced-motion drops the chip / thumb / offer-button transitions and the offer animation.
